purpose: Maps the v41 child school-support demand/friction signal into the same canonical Stödassistenten regression system.

mappings.product_miss: The canonical lab already knew that diagnosis is not required for school support, but the public family journey still treated 'school' as only a generic family choice and returned benefit-oriented family rows. A parent could therefore reach Omvårdnadsbidrag, merkostnadsersättning and municipal support without a focused Skolverket path, while the product failed to distinguish no clear school action, insufficient extra adjustments and a formal action-programme decision.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Reuse the existing child age guard, never ask diagnosis as a required route fact, and add exactly one high-information school-state question. Route within the same person product to current Skolverket guidance for needs/adjustments or prompt special-support investigation, and only show the official appeal path when the user says a formal action-programme decision exists. Do not create a school app or a separate child matcher.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not transfer or store the child's name, school, diagnosis, healthcare details, action-programme contents or raw story in URLs, public evals or feedback. Retain only coarse actor/focus/language and non-sensitive route state in the UI; feedback remains structured anonymous product feedback.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Do not promote the new Skolverket support record to VERIFIED by automation. Diagnosis rules, extra adjustments, special-support investigation, action-programme requirements and appealability remain primary-source governed and subject to human review before material fields become VERIFIED.
